item.title: Iran grants permission for some Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz
item.description: Iraqi President Nizar Amidi says his country's territory will not be used to launch attacks against any other state.

item.title: Why is Israel building new illegal settlements?
item.description: Israel opens construction bids for new illegal housing units in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: More than 200,000 newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan region
item.description: Intensified fighting in Sudan has displaced at least 200,000 people in the Kordofan region since late last year.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill two and injure others as Gaza attacks continue
item.description: Israeli drone attack targeted a family in the central city of Deir el-Balah, killing one person and wounding others.

item.title: Putin warns Ukraine has opened ‘Pandora’s box’, rejects peace proposals
item.description: In an interview with the Russian channel Vesti, Vladimir Putin threatened Ukraine's 'most vulnerable' economic sectors.

item.title: Envoy says Israel did not give the US notice before strikes on Syrian base
item.description: US official Tom Barrack has criticised Israel for failing to give his country adequate warning, a claim Tel Aviv denies.

item.title: Canada to match US tariffs “dollar for dollar,” PM Carney says
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match new US tariffs “dollar for dollar."

item.title: Carney: Canada will enact retaliatory US tariffs starting September 8
item.description: The prime minister spoke hours after the US imposed 50 percent tariffs on nearly $20bn worth of Canadian goods.

item.title: Israel, Turkiye and the new regional reordering
item.description: In Syria, Israel is not only at odds with Turkiye but also with the regional and international consensus.

item.title: Swedish police identify 17-year-old girl as victim in school sword attack
item.description: Brinell School's principal says 18-year-old suspected of carrying out Friday's deadly sword attack was a student there.

item.title: Armed men kidnap dozens in attacks on Nigerian villages
item.description: Police say three villages and a mosque were attacked, and worshippers kidnapped in central Niger State.

item.title: Israel’s Chief Rabbi says Palestinians are not a people and have no rights
item.description: Israel’s Chief Rabbi denied Palestinians are a people, claimed Gaza for Jews and called for its destruction and return.

item.title: Trump seeks to block the BBC’s attempt to subpoena Ivanka Trump, Trump Jr
item.description: While lawyers for the US president argue the subpoenas are 'cynical', the BBC says they could help shine light on case.

item.title: ‘Not a small issue’: People deported by US to Liberia face uncertain future
item.description: Liberia's government announced the move on Tuesday, two days before the flight. Politicians say they were not consulted.

item.title: Seven killed, including two police officers, in UK ‘wrong-side’ car crash
item.description: Accident follows similar crashes in Ireland where police highlighted social media trend driving in opposite direction.

item.title: South Korea sending first container ship through Arctic route
item.description: PanStar Acro, bound for Europe via Arctic, is testing whether a route opened by melting sea ice is commercially viable.

item.title: Sanctioned by EU, Israeli settler steals and kills Palestinian donkey
item.description: A donkey belonging to a Palestinian farmer was reportedly stolen and dragged to death by Israeli settlers.

item.title: LIVE: Espanyol vs Real Madrid: La Liga
item.description: Follow updates as Jose Mourinho returns to lead Madrid - including the build-up, analysis and live text commentary.

item.title: How is the pro-Israel lobby influencing US elections?
item.description: As the 2026 US midterms approach, millions of dollars are pouring into races involving candidates who challenge Israel.

item.title: Elche vs Barcelona: La Liga – prediction, team news, lineups
item.description: Barcelona start their season at Elche in La Liga on Sunday but will do so without their new signing, Rodri.

item.title: Walk-In “Human Fridges” are Japan’s newest heatwave weapon
item.description: Designed to stop heatstroke in its tracks, the "Do Hiemon Box" delivers rapid, targeted cooling during extreme weather.

item.title: Did DOGE cuts make America’s food safety problem worse?
item.description: The US has recorded more than 160 food recalls this year, as a Cyclospora outbreak has sickened nearly 11,000 people.

item.title: Settlers target Palestinian homes in Occupied West Bank’s Area B
item.description: Palestinians in Qaryut say Israeli settlers, backed by the military, are forcing families from their homes.

item.title: Over 100 ex-diplomats urge France, UK to sanction Israel over Palestine
item.description: An open letter demands a ban on arms transfers and a freeze on EU-Israel and UK-Israel trade agreements.

item.title: Israeli drone strike on ‘civilian vehicle’ injures several in Syria
item.description: Syria condemns attack in southwest as a 'flagrant violation of sovereignty' and a 'blatant breach of international law'.
